status: source-only; no build or timing authorized
candidate_source_rule: Exact current-main profiler intake must be supplied, source/relevance frozen and independently reviewed before the one build. No guessed main/head or mutable branch reference. Both arms use that exact same resulting binary and package.

historical_anchor.comparison: Functional unchanged-workload anchor only; profilev2 timings remain historical. No schema bridge or cross-version5percent result.

build.target_assignment: Requires explicit lease and free-space review; no target allocated by this proposal.

functional_controls.historical_anchor: Rehash and compare the existing full unprofiled report/PCM and existing Core-win/stress observations. Re-run old binary only if separately authorized; no reuse as current timing.
functional_controls.required: Identical full reports after removing only profile and exact PCM bytes/hash; preserve every failure; verify package/source before and after.

timing.baseline_selection: M0, fixed before execution, never fastest/best-of; retained even if gate fails. D0 anchors detailed repetition context.
timing.cross_mode_policy: Descriptive difference between independently observed quantile intervals only. Never call strict comparison across modes or remove identity fields.
timing.same_mode_repeat_policy: Strict mac_performance comparison M1/M0, M2/M0 and D1/D0, D2/D0, labeled repeated-run stability rather than engine improvement.

metrics.gate_scope: Per-mode all-frame script.tick p95 includes host setup, callbacks, validation/cleanup/commit and the selected heap observation. No subtracting telemetry or callback means.
metrics.callback_context: Existing ordered-source wall and threadCPU totals /2156; require exactly2source rows,2156calls each,0unwind/unavailableCPU. These are means, not callbackp95, and do not establish a guest-loop improvement.
metrics.heap: 2156VM observations,0invalid; detailed2156detail samples,maintained0; retained logical counter limits32MiB, estimates nullable only for maintained; maxima sampled only.

required_prelaunch: Exact current-main candidate SHA and immutable export/tool/SDK/vendor/lock closure
